title: Nikkō Kanaya Hotel
scope: Standing Nikkō Kanaya Hotel above Hachiishi-machi, including the 1893 Main Building with its 1936 stone ground floor, New Building, 1935 Annex and 1961 Second New Building.
limitations: The footprint of the outdoor stair and porte-cochère, heights, shutters, rail spacing, material colors and modern service details are approximate.
The standing hotel is modeled, including the raised stone plinth under the historic timber hotel. The early archival photo guides the upper timber floors and period architectural details.
The detached garden viewing pavilions, landscaped features, signs, interior fittings and courtyard furnishings are outside this exterior model.
